description: This file defines core service management classes and interfaces for a plugin or service architecture within the WPEFramework. It includes service metadata, factory, and administrator classes, as well as macros for interface querying and registration.

classes.name: IServiceMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about a service, including name, module, and version info.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration, instantiation, and lifecycle of services.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Template class representing a service instance, managing reference counting and interface querying.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Template class for sink objects with reference counting, used for event or callback handling.

classes.name: ServiceMetadata
classes.description: Template class that implements service metadata and registration, including nested ServiceImplementation class.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create service interface instances.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the service or sink.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of the service or sink.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a service metadata and factory with the ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a service metadata and factory.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service based on library, name, version, and interface number.
